notes.title: Pivot
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

I know it has been a while ... but I've been reviewing the state of the game, the feedback I've been getting as a well as the expected return for the project. 
And unfortunately, we've reached a pivot point. 
Grimm & Tonic and its characters have been with me for over 3 years. And I'm grateful for the opportunity to build and explore a world in which they can 'live & breathe. 

However, the scope of the game has proven larger than anticipated and I fear that the original message behind the story would be lost in additional episodes.

To that end, I will be [u]re-writing episodes 1, 2 & 3[/u] to be more in-line with the original focus for the project and to bring the story to a satisfying conclusion. 

The official full launch date for the Grimm & Tonic will be [b]31/10/2019[/b]

The game will release with the following features:
[list]
[*] 3 episodes
[*] 3 B-Side stories
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] A total of 20 memorable characters
[*] A Jazzy, Noir, Manga-inspired Aesthetic
[*] Choices that matter!
[/list]


In light of the reduced scope, the final price for the game will be [b]$4.99 USD[/b]. 
For those who have supported the game at its original price of [b]$9.99 USD[/b], I ask that you sign up to [b][url=https://mailchi.mp/31085f0c4965/grimmfree]this mailing list[/url][/b], so as to receive an additional free key at full launch.

Thanks for the continued support!
Stay tuned for more, 
Spritewrench.
